title: When the tongue gets ahead of the soul
issueStatement: Your words are sharper than your conscience, or sweeter than your heart actually is.
centralInsight: Guru does not treat speech as cosmetic. Speech reveals what the heart is feeding on and what it still loves too much.
practicalReflection: The same mouth can protect dignity, wound people, advertise ego, or carry Naam. The question is not whether you speak, but what spirit your speech serves.
actionPrompt: Choose one conversation today where you will lower the heat, refuse contempt, and speak in a way you can still respect tonight.
